messages:
Aisha: Heads up — MerchantX invoice 2026-03-15 for $24,600 is stuck in AP approvals. It references PO 45123 but the approver routing shows "entity mismatch".
Ben: Can you paste the invoice header & PO info? quick guess: wrong legal entity or cost center.
Aisha: Invoice snippet: 
Vendor: MerchantX
Invoice#: MX-9987
PO: 45123
GL/Cust: infra-dev
Amount: $24,600
System error: approver routing failed (entity_id 77 vs 12)
Sara: Thanks — looks like PO 45123 is tied to the old infra-dev project (entity 77). MerchantX renewal was moved to Platform billing (entity 12) in Jan.
Tom MerchantX: We submitted the invoice to the billing email on file, happy to re-issue if that helps. The PO shown on our side is 45123 as well.
Ben: If PO is for a different entity the approval workflow won't match. We can either: 1) update the PO to the Platform entity (needs PO owner sign-off) or 2) create an exception so AP can route it manually.
Aisha: Who's the PO owner? I can't find an owner in the PO record (legacy vendor onboarding). @Sara can you look up owner/created_by?
Sara: PO owner = @Michael (left 2024). There is no active owner. Suggest reassign to @Lena (Platform PM) and ask MerchantX to re-send invoice referencing new PO if needed.
Tom MerchantX: We can re-issue with the new PO number but need confirmation of the correct PO — otherwise will delay processing another 2–3 weeks.
Aisha: Short term: can AP do manual exception so payment isn't delayed? We have a committed renewal window.
Sara: I can open an AP exception ticket. Need: MerchantX confirmation email + copy of the PO and a note saying to charge Platform entity. Tom, can you reply in-thread confirming?
Tom MerchantX: Confirmed — please charge to Platform billing (entity 12). Will email invoice re-issue if you prefer.
InvoiceBot: Payment hold flagged for MX-9987 — status: waiting_for_ap_exception (rule 403)
Ben: Perfect — Sara please escalate the exception (tag: urgent-payment). Aisha, can you CC procurement to reassign PO ownership to Lena?
Aisha: Done. Procurement notified and cc'd Lena. Sara, ping me when exception ticket created and I'll follow up with vendor.
Sara: Exception ticket created #AP-8721, assigned to AP Ops. ETA 48 hours. Leaving note to prioritize due to renewal window.
Aisha: Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll track and update once AP confirms payment date.
Tom MerchantX: Thanks all — appreciate the fast turn. I will hold off re-issuing until you confirm if needed.
